messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from the RFC: we need an explicit contract for trickle streaming + retries. Short proposed rules.

mike: TL;DR?

anya: Rules: 1) Resume only from server-acked offsets. 2) Hedging allowed only before any byte emitted. 3) Full request retry is last resort.

sofia: Agree on server-acked offset. Clients must get an ack header after each chunk: `x-redwood-resume-offset`.

raj: Resume token should include route, model-version, offset, exp, and a nonce. Signed via KMS per-region.

lin: Billing: hedged attempts before first byte are free for customers (only winner billed). After first byte, duplicates count as duplicated_bytes unless route opts out.

mike: Observability: emit `resume.attempt`, `resume.accepted`, `resume.rejected:reason`, `hedge.spawned`, `hedge.win`. Include tags for `offset` and `pod`.

security: Must use KMS-signed tokens and server-side nonce replay prevention. Log resume rejects for audit.

anya: Example edge config snippet: {"streaming.resume_window_s":"8","streaming.hedge_before_first_byte_ms":"250","streaming.retry_policy":"resume|hedge|none"}. Per-route override required for side-effectful endpoints.

sofia: Tests: resume after partial ack; resume when model-version changed -> reject 409; hedging race where winner wins and metrics reflect hedged_tokens.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: r/edge-streaming-retry-2026-03-23

anya: I'll write the addendum with a tiny state machine and header names. Raj+Mike to review. Closing thread.
